kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Parthian *bwrz-ʾxw (/⁠burz-axw⁠/, “height, unsurmountable passage”), from Parthian bwrz (/⁠burz⁠/, “high”) + ʾxw (/⁠axw⁠/, “world”).
g: netherworld; barzakh; hades; purgatory (otherworldly existence, generally temporal, which may include elements of punishment and/or reward)
